line: A coffee cup chases a runaway sugar cube around the kitchen, 1930s-cartoon style.
line_cn: 一只咖啡杯满厨房追一块逃跑的方糖。

transitions: Transitions: iris, a hard cut on a beat, a title card rolling up like a window shade;
labels: Subtitles are a period title card: a small near-black plate with a white double-rule border and dot-and-ring corner ornaments; text in IM Fell English SC (~36 px), paper white. Drawn in the scene layer so it weaves and flickers with the film; pops on and off with no fades. Bottom by default, top when the action is low. One card may span two short voice clips; hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Titles: Shrikhand fat retro script, white face, heavy ink outline (~14 % of the cap height), ink drop shadow down-right; letters can hop in a travelling wave on the beat. Sub-lines in Limelight caps.
motion: Characters on twos (12 fps); camera moves on ones (24 fps). A stepped camera reads as judder.
Tempo grid: choose a tempo where one beat is an even whole number of frames at 24 fps (8, 10, 12, 16 or 20 frames), so every beat lands on a drawing of the twos.

Breathing: every idle object squashes and stretches with cos(2π·beats): an extreme on every beat (stretch on the beat, squash on the off-beat), sampled on twos, amplitude ~5–7 %, all props in phase. A peak of joy can raise the amplitude ×3 and squash the whole background painting around the floor line (~2.5 %).
Walk: one step per beat with a body bob (sad = smaller steps, limp arms). Run: legs as a windmill (feet orbit a circle), lean forward, speed lines.

native_moves.name: Everything breathes on the beat
native_moves.does: The setting is a character; at the peak the whole world can dance in sync, walls included.
native_moves.fits: a factory at shift change; a garden after rain; a city waking up.

native_moves.name: Mickey-mousing
native_moves.does: Every step is a note; a prop becomes an instrument.
native_moves.fits: stairs as a piano; a typewriter as a drum kit; fence posts as a xylophone.

native_moves.name: Rubber-hose stretch
native_moves.does: Limbs reach any length in one unbroken shot.
native_moves.fits: reaching a top shelf; a long-distance handshake; catching a falling baby bird.

native_moves.name: Transformation
native_moves.does: Anything becomes something else mid-motion (a tail into a question mark, a hose into a saxophone).
native_moves.fits: an idea turning into a product; a problem into a tool; a word into an object.

native_moves.name: The bouncing-ball singalong
native_moves.does: Lyrics on a title card, a ball hopping from word to word on the beat.
native_moves.fits: a jingle; a safety rhyme; a slogan to remember.

native_moves.name: The film is a physical object
native_moves.does: Title cards roll up like window shades; the iris is grabbed and pulled shut; intertitles get bumped; the frame line slips.
native_moves.fits: a brand reveal; a "the end?" twist; a character escaping the cartoon.

native_moves.name: The ink bottle
native_moves.does: An artist's pen draws the hero, who then argues with it.
native_moves.fits: a making-of; a mascot introduction; a lesson about drawing.
